name: Armchair
description: A deep upholstered armchair with padded rolled arms, loose cushions and short wooden feet.
notes: rest mirrors the furniture chair and sofa in furniture.jsonnet: the reference allows sleeping in it, poorly. At 27 kg it is a carry-it-across-the-room item, not a pocket one; dragging furniture has no content field yet. No upholstery finish exists: cloth-shirt-faded stands in for a worn reddish-brown fabric.

name: Bar stool
description: A tall stool with a padded round leather seat on a steel column, a foot ring and a heavy round base.
notes: CHECK VOLUME: the reference's 30 L is what the stool displaces, while the look compares it with its open bounding box. No sleep: the reference rules it out.

name: Bean bag
description: A big slumped nylon sack of foam beads, pressed into a seat with a high back.
notes: Drawn sat-in, low in front and bunched at the back, so it reads as a seat. No nylon finish exists: cloth-navy draws the sack and plastic-charcoal the seam and carry loop. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Plywood chair
description: A stacking chair with a plywood seat and backrest on a round steel tube frame.
notes: Drawn as a school or canteen chair. CHECK VOLUME: an open frame chair fills little of its bounding box; the reference's 30 L is its displaced volume. wood-birch draws the plywood.

name: Wooden chair
description: A plain wooden chair with a solid seat, low stretchers and a spindle back.
notes: rest matches the furniture chair. The black and white chairs differ only in paint, so they share this model, drawn in stained oak; a painted finish per variant has no model field yet. CHECK VOLUME: an open frame chair fills little of its bounding box; the reference's 30 L is its displaced volume.

name: Log stool
description: A short round of tree trunk in rough bark, its top sawn flat and smoothed.
notes: The reference makes it from a log, so it also has crafting origins. Drawn 300 mm across and 420 mm tall rather than at the reference's 500 mm longest side, so the round's volume stays near the reference's 20 L at its 11 kg. No bark finish exists: wood-walnut draws the bark, wood-pine the sawn face and wood-oak its heart and growth ring.

name: Wooden stool
description: A small square wooden stool on four legs joined by stretchers.
notes: rest is below the chair's because it has no back. The reference makes it from planks, so it also has crafting origins.

name: Aluminium foot locker
description: A ribbed aluminium trunk with steel corner caps, a folding handle at each end and a small lock on its front hasp.
notes: Drawn shut and empty at the reference's 3.7 kg. The steel foot locker shares this model: same shape, heavier at 6.5 kg, and drawn in aluminium until a variant can carry its own finish. Locking the lid has no content field yet. The pocket grid is a placeholder.
